name: Dagger hilt
dimensions: Length 136 mm; Height 65.8 mm; Depth 32.0 mm; Length 66.4 mm
summary: The white nephrite jade hilt of this dagger, inlaid with banded agate in gold, was probably made in China in the 18th century. It imitates a Mughal model of the late 17th century. Mughal jade was greatly admired in China at this period, and many jades in Mughal style were made for the emperor Qianlo

collection.museum: 维多利亚与艾尔伯特博物馆
